top_signals.title: US inflation rises to 3.8% ahead of December Fed meeting, clouding crypto outlook
top_signals.summary: US core inflation rose more than expected in October as markets anticipate a December interest rate hike, which could slow a crypto market recovery.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Nvidia agrees to $290 million settlement over crypto mining disclosures amid Jensen Huang turmoil
top_signals.summary: Nvidia agreed to a $290M settlement over claims it misled investors about crypto mining demand driving 2017–18 gaming GPU sales.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Asian Equities Advance After Late Rebound in US: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Asian stocks rose after dip buyers helped drive a late recovery on Wall Street, even as doubts over the sustainability of the artificial intelligence trade sent investors to the safety of Treasuries.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Would-Be RadioShack Revivers Settle SEC Fraud Suit Allegations
top_signals.summary: Three entrepreneurs accused of misleading investors about pandemic-era plans to revive distressed retailers including RadioShack and Pier 1 Imports agreed to pay more than $6.8 million to end a US regulator’s lawsuit claiming they were running a Ponzi-like scam.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
